senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced.) [to surround, tie up,] to conceal.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 981:3">Yalk. Cant. 981</cite>, v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>עָלוּם</he>; f. <cite ref="P00776"><he>עֲלוּמָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>עֲלוּמִים</he>, <he>עֲלוּמִין</he>; <he>עֲלוּמוֹת</he>.
Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ (play on עֲלָמוֹת, Cant. I, 3) קרי ביה עלומות read it ʿălumoth (secret things).

senses.gloss: <cite ref="P00819">same</cite>. Part. pass. <cite ref="M02081"><he>מְעוּלָּם</he></cite>; f. <he>מְעוּלֶּמֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְעוּלָּמִים</he>, <he>מְעוּלָּמִין</he>; <he>מְעוּלָּמוֹת</he>.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 46:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVI, 1</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00825"><he>עלמות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 46:1">ib.</cite>) <he>מע׳ הן הדברים וכ׳</he> the things we saw are hidden, we know not what we saw.

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְעַלֵּם to be concealed, to escape; to hide one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:6">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אין כל דבר נ׳ ממך</he> nothing is unknown to thee. Y. Pes. VI, beg. 33ᵃ <he>נֶעֶלְמָה הלכה ממנו</he> the law escaped his memory; Bab.

<cite ref="Pesachim 66a:3">Pes. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>נִתְעַלְּמָה</he>. Y. Yoma III, 40ᵈ bot. <he>לא … מִתְעַלֵּם מהן</he> they did not move from there before it (the pronunciation of the Tetragrammaton) escaped their memory again. Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ top <he>עד שיִתְעַלֵּם מעיניהם</he> until he is left out of their sight. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ <he>ואל תִּתְעַלֵּם מתחינתנו</he> do not hide thyself (turn away) from our prayer; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:25">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="E00718"><he>העלמה</he></cite> <cite ref="Exodus 2:8">Ex. II, 8</cite>) <he>שהֶעֱלִימָה וכ׳</he> she kept her own secret.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00825"><he>עלמות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:3">ib.</cite>) <he>על שהֶעֱלַמְתָּ מהם יום וכ׳</he> because thou hast concealed from them the day of death and the day of consolation, they love thee; <he>על שהעלמת מתן וכ׳</he> because thou hast concealed from them the reward of the righteous &c.; Yalk. ib. 981 <he>שעָלַמְתָּ</he> (Kal); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (v. עָלַם I) הע׳ עינים to close the eyes, to lose sight of. Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ bot.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 10b:8">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>ואל תַּעֲלֵם עיניך ממני</he> do not avert thy eyes from me.
<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:20">Tosef. Peah IV, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:3">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>המעלים … מן הצדקה</he> who closes his eyes to charity; a. fr.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">Koh. R. to III, 11</cite> (play on <cite ref="E00717"><he>הָעֹלָם</he></cite> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:11">ib.</cite>) <he>ה׳ מהם שם וכ׳</he> the pronunciation of the Tetragrammaton was concealed from them.
